text:
Sam: Quick idea — small riverside potluck + board game lunch this Friday? Weather looks good. Meet at Riverbend steps at 12:30. I'll bring bento + blankets. Who's in? :sun_with_face:
Maya: In! I'll bring iced tea (pitcher) and some fruit.
Jon: Depends on a morning shipping run but likely in. Can we push to 12:15? That helps my schedule.
Priya: Love this. I can bring Codenames and Wingspan. Also vegetarian sushi.
Aisha: Count me in. I'll bring a portable speaker and a box of cupcakes. :cupcake: 
Marco: If it's 12:30 I'm out, 1pm works better for me :shrug:
Sam: Thanks — quick poll: 12:15 / 12:30 / 1:00. Reply with 1/2/3. Also bring plates/utensils if you can.
Maya: 2
Priya: 2
Jon: 1 (I can try to shift my run)
Aisha: 3
lunchbot: Poll created: 12:15(1) — 12:30(2) — 1:00(3). Current results: 12:30 leading. Calendar invite sent to #office-all — please RSVP.
Sam: I'll bring extra napkins and low-sugar drinks. @Priya can you shepherd games? :game_die:
Priya: Yep happy to organize games. I'll pack rules + spare cards.
Sam: Great — see you Friday! Weather backup: Rooftop breakroom if rain. :umbrella:
